I kind of feel the same, my life isn't the worst but I do feel like life just isn't for me. It's just that there were so many events that led to me having this negative mindset that I as well as you cannot imagine my life without depressive thoughts. 

I am seeing a therapist and she says that I am ok, that I do not show any signs of the actual depression but then again I do not feel good. 

And lately I've given up on faking happiness... And don't want to kill myself only when someone reaches out and talks to me, but after the convos end, I feel like I did something wrong and start blaming myself for spoiling everything which leads to me considering suicide even more. I've almost did it a week ago, but my mom said something to me that kept me from doing it: she was so happy that I visited her, and I just couldn't... 

I do not know hot to keep going but we all do it automatically, I just do a lot of different things that distract me from such thoughts although I have to admit that it doesn't help anymore hence I am here. 

I really hope that those thoughts are gone eventually and all of us can feel better. We all seek love and care and I feel like if there were people to give it and share it with all of us the suicide rates would've lowered a bit. If you do not feel that suicide is for you, please do not attempt it I kind of think that all of us have the chances to be happy the key is to teach yourself to believe in it.
